rules: Preserve v1 review documents and signatures unchanged. The timed archive uses a distinct document type, review scope and hash/signature domains; v1 signatures cannot authorize this review.
Require exactly one freeze_authority signature under the unchanged external trust manifest, with all three trust signatures and role validity/revocation checks.
Require independently expected review and trust digests plus the unchanged external review observation. A hash supplied from the same review is not independent approval.

Bind the eight-file archive commitment, reviewed evidence commit/tree, actual first-live completion time and independently verified subject. The outer verifier must derive these expectations from archive and historical Git rather than copy them from the review.
Keep the ordered completion/evidence/review/observation/candidate-freeze timeline. Rejected reviews may have valid signatures but cannot become eligible.
Review signature verification alone proves neither archive integrity, historical source equality, installed dependencies, registry admission nor live execution. These remain distinct required gates.
